name: K. V. Dominic

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: K. V. Dominic is an Indian English poet, fiction writer, critic and editor whose literary work grew alongside a career teaching English at Newman College in Thodupuzha, Kerala. His author biography records his retirement in 2011 and his earlier editorship of the Indian Journal of Postcolonial Literatures. Winged Reason is among his poetry collections.

His poems in Kabita Live bring questions of justice into everyday scenes. ‘Equity must begin at home’ challenges unequal treatment of women, while ‘On War and Peace’ asks readers to imagine suffering beyond their own borders. ‘Advent of Monsoon’ sets the beauty of rain against the danger it brings to vulnerable households. In ‘Bunyan Tree: Happy New Year’, a sheltering tree questions the distance between festive greetings and care for other lives.
